pois.name: Rif Fort
pois.intro: Le Musée du Fort Rif est un musée situé à Willemstad sur l'île de Curaçao.

pois.name: Willemstad
pois.intro: Willemstad is the capital and largest city of Curaçao, an island in the southern Caribbean Sea that is a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. It was the capital of the Netherlands Antilles prior to that entity's dissolution in 2010.

pois.name: Koningin Emmabrug
pois.intro: The Queen Emma Bridge is a pontoon bridge across St. Anna Bay on Curaçao island in the Dutch Caribbean.

pois.name: Museum Kurá Hulanda
pois.intro: The Kurá Hulanda Museum is an anthropological museum located in the Kura Hulanda Village district of Willemstad, Curaçao. The museum teaches about the Atlantic slave trade, and African history in the Caribbean, and was opened in April 1999 by Jacob Gelt Dekker.

pois.name: Waterfort
pois.intro: Waterfort is a fort in Willemstad, Curaçao located on the eastern side of the Sint Anna Bay. It was built in 1827 to protect Willemstad against attack.

pois.name: Curaçao Museum
pois.intro: The Curaçao Museum is an art and cultural history museum in Curaçao. The museum opened on 7 March 1948, and is the oldest museum in Curaçao which still exists.

pois.name: Jewish Cultural Historical Museum
pois.intro: Het Joods Cultureel Historisch Museum is een cultuurhistorisch museum in de wijk Punda in Willemstad. Het is in 1970 gesticht en verbonden aan de Mikvé Israël-Emanuelsynagoge.

pois.name: NAAM
pois.wikipedia: fr:Musée national d'anthropologie archéologique de Curaçao
pois.intro: Le Musée national d'anthropologie archéologique est un musée ouvert en 1998 situé à Willemstad sur l'île de Curaçao.

pois.name: Octagon Museum
pois.intro: Het Octagon Museum, ook bekend als het Bolívarhuis of Museo Bolivariano, is een klein museum in Willemstad, Curaçao. Het is gelegen aan de Penstraat in de wijk Pietermaai op het terrein van het "Avila Beach Hotel".

pois.name: Fort Kerk museum
pois.intro: Fortkerk Museum er et museum i Fort Amsterdam i Willemstad, hovedstaden på Curaçao. Kirken i Fort Amsterdam stammer fra andre halvdel av 1700-tallet og har byggeåret 1769 på fasaden.

pois.name: Riffort Lighthouse
pois.intro: This is a list of lighthouses in Curaçao.

pois.name: Curaçao Sea Aquarium
pois.intro: L'aquarium de Curaçao est un aquarium situé à Willemstad.

pois.name: Children's Museum Curaçao
pois.description: Children's Museum Curacao offers 11 different interactive exhibitions for children and families. Come play in the indoor and outdoor areas of the museum and discover, learn and experiment.

pois.name: Punda
pois.intro: Willemstad is the capital and largest city of Curaçao, an island in the southern Caribbean Sea that is a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. It was the capital of the Netherlands Antilles prior to that entity's dissolution in 2010.

pois.name: Pietermaai
pois.intro: Pietermaai is a neighbourhood and former suburb of Willemstad, on Curaçao, a Lesser Antilles island in the Dutch Caribbean. Pietermaai was founded in 1675, and has been designated a Unesco World Heritage Site.

pois.name: Penha
pois.intro: El Penhagebouw​​ es el nombre que recibe una casa de comercio en el centro de Willemstad la ciudad capital de la isla de Curazao,​ una dependencia organizada como país autónomo del Reino de los Países Bajos.​ El edificio se encuentra en el distrito de Punda y fue construido en el siglo XVIII. Se utiliza tanto como un almacén, y como una residencia. Se trata de una popular atracción turística.

pois.name: Landhuis Chobolobo
pois.description: At Landhuis Chobolobo you can visit the Curacao Liqueur Distillery, the place where the world-famous Blue Curacao is produced. You can experience and learn all about the production process and enjoy the taste such as it has been produced since 1896.

pois.name: Fleur de Marie
pois.intro: Fleur de Marie is een buurt in Willemstad. De buurt ligt op een rotsachtige helling ten noordwesten van Scharloo.

pois.name: DeliNova
pois.description: DeliNova is uw groothandel in delicatessen en meer. Wij leveren de beste kwaliteit vlees, vis, kaas, groenten, fruit en koffie. Bij DeliNova branden we onze eigen noten en bakken we het lekkerste brood af. Daarnaast zijn we importeur van een groot aantal

pois.name: Crafted by Angel atelier
pois.address: 38 Kaya Alonso de Ojeda, Saliña Harbour View
pois.description: Unique potpourris, decorations, soaps, scrubs, massage oils, organic lavender and more, as souvenir, gift or give away for any special occasion.

pois.name: Rif Mangrove Park
pois.intro: Het Curaçao Rif Mangrove Park is een stads- en natuurpark in Otrobanda, een wijk van Willemstad op het Nederlands-Caraïbische eiland Curaçao. Het park werd door prinses Beatrix geopend op 1 juli 2022.

pois.name: Blue Bay Beach
pois.intro: Blue Bay is a beach on the Caribbean island of Curaçao, located close to the fishermen's village of Sint-Michiel to the north-west of Willemstad. The beach is named after a plantation "Blaauw" that was located nearby.

pois.name: Baya Beach
pois.intro: Baya Beach is one of 38 official beaches on the Caribbean island of Curaçao, situated on a peninsula in the south-east of Caracas Bay next to Fort Beekenburg. It used to be a bunker port of Royal Dutch Shell; some piers and tanks can still be seen.

pois.name: Sint Michielsberg
pois.intro: De Sint Michielsberg is een heuvel en archeologische vindplaats ten noorden van het dorp Sint Michiel op het Nederlands-Caribische eiland Curaçao. De Sint Michielsberg heeft een hoogte van 105,2 meter boven zeeniveau.
